summary: Enforce reader ownership consistency at graph and library write boundaries (#3225): prove no thread frontier escapes its own thread and no reading session points at another reader's thread before the ownership triggers are installed.

preflight_checks.name: no thread frontier escapes its own thread
preflight_checks.condition: every threads.next_unread_issue_id references an issue whose thread_id equals the thread's own id
preflight_checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM threads t JOIN issues i ON i.id = t.next_unread_issue_id WHERE i.thread_id <> t.id

preflight_checks.name: no reading session points at another reader's thread
preflight_checks.condition: every sessions.pending_thread_id references a thread whose user_id equals the session's own user_id
preflight_checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sessions s JOIN threads t ON t.id = s.pending_thread_id WHERE t.user_id <> s.user_id
